questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Function Inner Product?
questions.answer: A function inner product multiplies two functions and integrates the result over an interval. It measures alignment between functions, just as a dot product measures alignment between vectors.

questions.prompt: What does \(f(x),g(x)\) mean in Function Inner Product?
questions.answer: In Function Inner Product, \(f(x),g(x)\) means functions on the same interval.

questions.prompt: Identify another important piece of notation used in Function Inner Product.
questions.answer: In Function Inner Product, \(a,b\) means interval endpoints.

questions.prompt: State a central formula or test for Function Inner Product.
questions.answer:
The function inner product is
\[\langle f,g\rangle=\int_a^b f(x)g(x)\,dx\]

questions.prompt: Compute the inner product of sin x and cos x over negative pi to pi.
questions.answer: Use the definition: \[\langle\sin x,\cos x\rangle=\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin x\cos x\,dx\] Since sin x cos x is an odd function, equal positive and negative areas cancel. Therefore \[\langle\sin x,\cos x\rangle=0\]
